posts.title: A Personal Code to Live By
posts.description: Finally, I am 35 yo. Finally, I can say “Midway upon the journey of our life I found myself within a forest dark, for the straightforward pathway had been lost” Let’s start with the principles I try to live by. I will update them as they change. 8 Nov 2026 Do not wish for others what you would not want for yourself. Goodwill desire to serve community and life is a must. Separate what is within you

posts.title: An Audit of Being Alive
posts.description: How much of what hurts are you carrying on purpose? Does the pain explain everything, or does it excuse everything? How much of your peace is real, and how much is just pretending? posts.title: What I Delegate to AI, and What I Don’t
posts.description: AI Usage Disclosure I use large language models in my work, including in the code in my public repositories.
